about: Notes for the conductor ores and carbonate (BACKLOG #49; SME docs/science/mars-conductor-and-carbonate-ores.md). The amounts themselves live in worldgen/placed_feature/<name>.json (rarity_filter chance = one cluster per that many chunks; one 256 x 256 area is 256 chunks) and worldgen/configured_feature/<name>.json (size = largest cluster). All amounts and places are INVENTED game balance.

mars:sulfide_vein.where: highland_mesa and rocky_flats, underground (y 20 to 75), so it shows in canyon walls and crater walls where the ground is cut
mars:sulfide_vein.target_density: 1 to 2 clusters of 3 to 6 blocks per 256 x 256 area (SME)

mars:magnetic_ore.where: highland_mesa only (the old high ground), y 10 to 60, deeper than 8 blocks
mars:magnetic_ore.target_density: 1 cluster of 3 to 5 blocks per 256 x 256 area (SME)

mars:carbonate_rock.where: dust_plain, rocky_flats and highland_mesa, underground (y 40 to 78), so craters expose it
mars:carbonate_rock.target_density: 4 to 8 blocks per patch, about 3 patches per 256 x 256 area (SME, INVENTED)

seed_kit_carbonate.fallback_note: If the owner prefers gypsum for the first kits (SME says it is acceptable, verified gypsum on Mars), add "mars:gypsum_vein" to data/mars/tags/item/seed_kit_carbonate.json. No code change. Carbonate teaches the CO2 link better, so it is the default.

not_built.mars:meteorite_iron: REAL optional block (Opportunity found iron meteorites). Not trivial: needs a surface placement feature and a drop rule; left out.
not_built.bone_meal_from_compost: No code. Vanilla composter already makes bone meal; the journal label is the Instructional Designer's.
